data.narrative:
Orbem is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised €55.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 4 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector at the same or adjacent stage, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach. The median valuation across these 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables is $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M at the low end (Eikon) to $10.3B at the high end (Colossal). Public-comp anchoring using P/S multiples from three listed Biotech & Health tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) with a median multiple of 5.6x cannot be applied, as Orbem's revenue is not available.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.9B to $4.0B, centered on a $3.5B median. The substantial gap between the low peer comparable ($539M) and the peer median reflects heterogeneity in stage and business profile within the Series B/C cohort. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the absence of revenue data precluding public-comp triangulation, and reliance on a limited peer set of 4 comparables with wide valuation dispersion.
